value.rationale: For a classical nonadjacent pair subsequence read channel motivated by skipped molecular measurements, exact capacity of a fixed sparse composition is a natural code-design invariant. The three-marker layer is the first nontrivial layer with eight possible run signatures and a parity-dependent leading image-growth coefficient, beyond the previously determined weight-two case. The complete realizability table provides a constructive profile classification, while the \(\Theta(n)\) observed outcomes versus \(\Theta(n^3)\) source configurations quantify a two-thirds loss in the leading sparse location-information coefficient. This all-length result supplies exact channel benchmarks, not a random small-instance or a tautological substitution.
